title: West Virginia DMV unveils mysterious new "Cryptids" license plate
excerpt: The West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles is unveiling a new license plate, available for sale on Monday, Nov. 2, 2026.
content:
CHARLESTON, W.Va. (WVVA) – The West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles is unveiling a new license plate, available for sale on Monday, Nov. 2, 2026.

The plate was designed by Jesse Corlis and features nine different Cryptids from the mountain state: Flatwoods Monster, Mothman, Bigfoot, Sheepsquatch, Batboy, Veggie Man, Werewolf, Ogua and Grafton Monster.

“First and foremost, I would like to pay tribute to Jesse Corlis, the talented graphic artist who designed the Cryptid license plate, along with several other license plates you see traveling the roads of West Virginia every day. One particularly popular design is the Pollinators plate, better known as the ‘Bee plate.” said DMV Commissioner Everett Frazier.

Corlis developed the plate while working at the Kanawha City DMV headquarters.

“Tragically, Jesse passed away in 2023 before he had the opportunity to see the Cryptid plate come to fruition,” said Frazier. “We recognize his creativity, talent and contributions to the West Virginia license plate program, and we are proud to see his work celebrated through this unique design.”
